title: Resolve number formatter
original_mips_findings: The 0x18-byte-frame function calls sprintf with D_801C7780_1C8380 as the destination, D_8007CF60_7DB60 as the format, and D_801C7740_1C8340 in $a2. The format bytes at ROM 0x7DB60 are `%d`; the destination low address is installed in the sprintf jal delay slot.
It first publishes the temporary buffer pointer in D_801C779C_1C839C. A nonzero first byte enters the digit loop; each ASCII byte is converted to a signed halfword by subtracting 0x30.

The loop loads the next byte, advances the two pointers, and uses `bnel $v1,$zero,loop` with `addiu $t8,$v1,-0x30` in the branch-likely delay slot. The final NUL does not emit a token because the delay slot is annulled when the branch is not taken.

The function writes a -1 halfword sentinel, publishes the sentinel pointer in D_801C77DC_1C83DC, calls func_8003EB34_3F734 with D_801C7754_1C8354 loaded in the jal delay slot, and returns void. A minus sign is converted by the same subtraction to -3.

prior_native_evidence.source: decomp/results/vm_next_ten_batch4.json and the 2026-11-09 formatter entries in PROGRESS.md
prior_native_evidence.other_recorded_comparator: A separate later isolated report recorded 9/41 relocation-masked positions, including 3/19 directly comparable positions. It used a distinct output/comparison path; neither report is a full-unit proof.
prior_native_evidence.stopping_evidence: None reproduced the original bnel delay-slot schedule. The historical object comparison did not retain a reliable first original-address mismatch word.

variant_accounting.v2_stop_reason: The previous 15 native variants already covered the supported sprintf, pointer, loop, and next-character hypotheses. No distinct instruction-level prediction remained; the v2 stop rule forbids another unsupported shape trial.

tests.focused_host_result: PASS 1,000/1,000 deterministic synthetic cases under ASan/UBSan, including zero, signed decimal boundaries, INT_MIN/INT_MAX, negative values, halfword sentinel, pointer destinations, guard slot, and callback count.

tests.original_guard_result: PASS: 41 original instruction addresses and 15 anchors verified; four parser/negative-control tests passed.
